capabilities.name: NB Development Defaults
capabilities.description: Global development defaults for this operator. Use for almost all coding, debugging, ChittyOS integration, architecture, compliance, auth/token, branch-finalization, and workflow-automation tasks unless the operator explicitly overrides these defaults. Covers conditional execute-now posture, discovery-first (service + capability), separated adversarial review, worktree isolation, broker-first credentials (1Password RETIRED), and non-interactive branch finalization.

capabilities.name: Startup Mode
capabilities.description: The operator's standing cost-discipline posture for this self-funded phase, and the single written source for it. Load it before any decision that creates, keeps, or justifies recurring spend — provisioning or re-provisioning a database, adding a Neon project or branch, adding a metered binding or paid SDK, adding a cron or long-lived poller that touches Postgres, adding CI to a private repo, choosing Postgres vs D1 vs R2 SQL vs KV vs Sheets, or claiming that a change saves money. Also load it when the words "startup mode", "lean", "cost", "spend", "cheaper", "scale to zero", or "off Neon" appear. It carries the three levers, the measurement precondition (comptroller cannot measure infra spend — Neon's consumption API is the source), the non-linear poller problem, and the boundary of what startup mode may never override.

capabilities.name: Repository Hygiene
capabilities.description: Repository hygiene and crash-safe work capture for any repo. Wraps the merged `can hygiene` and `can wip` surfaces so a synth can run them against a target repo — config auditing, uncommitted-work capture to refs/wip, orphan recovery, and mergeability-based branch lifecycle with archive-before-delete.

capabilities.name: Gauntlet
capabilities.description: Recursive adversarial convergence for any decision surface with code, a fixture corpus, and a runner (validators, gates, parsers, routers, policy engines, schedulers). Contests the expectations, hunts missing cases, traces execution, audits standing mandates, then loops an adaptive feeder against a separated implementer until dry, verified by an agent told not to trust either. Invoke from any Claude Code session as `Workflow({name: "chittyos-core:gauntlet", args: {target, runner, ...}})`; pass `dryRun: true` first to validate args and see the agent budget without dispatching anything.

capabilities.name: Finance Operating Defaults
capabilities.description: Finance Operating Constitution — books only. The default operating posture for bookkeeping, chart-of-accounts, classification, reconciliation, and financial-write work, across every runtime (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, ChittyOS agents). Load it whenever the work touches a chart of accounts, a ledger, a classification, a reconciliation, a tax-form derivation, or any write to a financial datastore — including when the request sounds trivial ("just fix that one account", "reseed the chart", "mark it deductible"). It governs HOW books work is conducted: the document is authoritative over the projection, a plan is not a write, never hand-write apply SQL, partial state is the default failure, reconcile by digest, tax semantics are separable from structure, production writes are operator-gated, trust path L0–L4, rollups hold no transactions, state the gaps, mutation-test every guard. It carries no entity facts and never will — no ownership percentages, no account numbers, no balances. The moment a financial figure is filed or asserted in a matter, it hands off to `legal-operating-defaults`.

capabilities.name: Document Intake Checks
capabilities.description: Per-document-type intake checks for legal evidence. Given a document, identify its type and run every check that type requires, emitting an explicit result for each — pass, fail, or unknown — so nothing is silently skipped. Runs BEFORE a fact is drafted, upstream of fact-governance's draft/verified/locked lifecycle. Triggers on "check this document", "what should I verify here", "intake checks", "doctype checks", "is this executed", "which balance", "entered or draft", or any first read of a new instrument, statement, order, or export.

capabilities.name: Evidence Egress
capabilities.description: Migrate evidence/document files out of scattered local source directories (Desktop, iCloud, Downloads, external) into the canonical pipeline (R2 + Drive mirror + local working copy). Read-only audit by default — produces per-case CSV reports of {in_neon, in_drive, action_needed} before any move or delete. Case-agnostic: discovers cases from <root>/cases/* and resolves Drive remotes by convention (sd_<case_id>:). Triggers on: 'egress', 'evidence egress', 'migrate evidence', 'free up desktop', 'iCloud evidence sprawl', 'audit before move', '/evidence-egress', 'where are the duplicates'.

capabilities.name: Evidence to Filing
capabilities.description: Convert an explicitly identified legal matter's already-governed evidence and verified facts into an attorney-reviewable filing package. Use when asked to turn a contradiction matrix, verified chronology, citation map, exhibit set, or evidence audit into litigation work product; build exhibit/Bates architecture; prepare a statement of facts, memorandum, motion shell, proposed order, service shell, or e-filing checklist; or make an evidence package filing-ready. Requires a named matter and preserves source-to-fact-to-exhibit traceability. It does not collect evidence, verify new facts, choose disputed legal relief, or silently label a package court-ready.

capabilities.name: ChittyServ Fleet Caretaker
capabilities.description: Use this agent for the ongoing care of the chittyserv compute fleet — the portable tower of Mac Mini and Dell micro nodes plus chittyserv-vm and chittyclaw. It is the standing caretaker: it watches node reachability and address drift, Nomad raft and Serf convergence, client heartbeat health, OS and image currency, and configuration drift, then either remediates within policy or files a durable finding. Invoke it for "is the fleet healthy", "why is a node unreachable", "why are clients not registering", "what is stale on the nodes", or on a schedule. It is NOT a service-endpoint health checker — `chitty-health` owns `*.chitty.cc/health`; this agent owns the machines underneath.

runtime_exclusions.openclaw: high mutation risk — restarts services and applies network config on live nodes; not exposed to the broad-execution runtime
